scripts.dev: npm run build -w @teamchat/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @teamchat/shared" "npm run dev -w @teamchat/server" "npm run dev -w @teamchat/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @teamchat/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @teamchat/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
